info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Loan Application Withdraw-spec
info.description: The Loan Application Withdrawal API allows users to formally withdraw their loan applications. This endpoint serves financial institutions and borrowers who need to cancel or retract their loan requests for various reasons. By providing the necessary application ID, users can ensure that their application is removed from consideration efficiently. This API is essential for maintaining updated application statuses and can be integrated into client applications for seamless user experience.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to withdraw a specific loan application identified by its unique reference number. Upon successful withdrawal, the application will be marked as withdrawn in the system, and any related processes will be halted.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to withdraw a loan application identified by the unique application ID 'RES-100045'. The payload must contain the necessary information to process the withdrawal request.

200.description: The loan application was successfully withdrawn.
